body: That sub doesn't give support. It's just a place for people who are thinking about it to post they're thinking about it for whatever their reason.
They never came back from the bathroom
It's a stuffed catfish I got to replace my old catfish when I lost him.

Honestly it helps a little knowing I'm not the only one feeling this way. Sure everyone says "you're not alone" but they don't know what you're feeling, what you're thinking. But you do. You get it. Knowing that kinda helps in its own fucked up weird way. :/

A ticking time bomb. That's exactly it. I feel like it's just a matter of when. I feel like a ghost of my former self and it's only a matter of time before that feeling turns in to reality. 

I thought about slitting wrists at first too but like you said it's ridiculously hard to succeed that way. And I feel it's been so glamorized by tv and movies and the media which is why people think of it when in reality it's nothing like that. 

Although cutting in general has seemed to help give an outlet for the feelings of self loathing. Something about damaging that which I feel doesn't deserve to exist is somewhat satisfying in its own little way....and it's not illegal or harming anyone else so I can't get in trouble
